title: Reschedule Allowance Terms for Extended Imaging and Procedure Authorizations
content:
When an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) is extended, the reschedule allowance of the added validity follows the booked study's own count of patient reschedules, as recorded on that In-Person Appointments visit:

- two or more reschedules give the repeat-reschedule allowance of 7 days;
- exactly one gives the single-reschedule allowance of 5 days;
- none gives no allowance.

The booked study is the In-Person Appointments visit booked against the authorization; only that study's own reschedule count is read, not the reschedules of the patient's other appointments. The allowance is a count of calendar days added to the added validity.

| Reschedules of the booked study | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 5 days |
| 2 | 7 days |
| 3 or more | 7 days |
